notes.title: Discover The Magical Witch Cards!
notes.content:
Hello, Magic Apprentices! 

We hope you’ve been having a magical experience in Affogato. As you journey through Arorua City, you’ll soon discover that it's not just your wits and decisions in the café that matter, but also on the mystical battlefield as you delve deeper into the minds of your customers. Here, your Witch cards aren't merely tools; they are your comrades in arms, ready to battle against inner demons. In this article, we’ll be taking you on a Witch Card tour as we showcase some of them, their abilities and how you can acquire them!

[h2]The Moon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/b61de606881a279b95cc7925bcdd4b8a0b3a3a26.gif[/img]
First off, we have The Moon, a Witch card that draws strength as the tides of battle change. Each time an ally falls or is summoned back, it empowers The Moon with random buffs such as HP regeneration, ATK increase, or a Penta charge. This unpredictable advantage keeps your strategies flexible and your opponents guessing. You can acquire The Moon card from Mephista’s shop. 

[h2]The Lovers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/ef3a5bf49d96ab2a3b46f67a24ab619f61f11156.gif[/img]
Next, meet The Lovers. United in adversity, this card is your sword and shield, reflecting damage dealt to them back to the enemy and ensuring that every confrontation is a double-edged clash. In addition, when fully charged, you’ll receive a The Lovers: Stealth card in your inventory which when cast, will bring your team into Stealth state for those decisive, blindsided strikes! You’ll acquire The Lovers card after defeating the Chapter 3 boss.

[h2]Judgment[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/fb14c2d5a5b4a6e8d72d4c8ab274104264cc9b35.gif[/img]
Behold Judgment, the luminous avenger. Unlike other Witch card, Judgment does not charge energy through its attacks. Instead, its luminous strikes imprint a Mark of Judgment on enemies. When you stack a total of 3 marks, witness a spectacular explosion of energy, dealing massive damage to the marked enemies. You can acquire the Judgment card from Mephista’s card shop.

[h2]The Empress[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/3a8769649131b07efefdd966023d7d82a4ede888.gif[/img]
The Empress is a Witch card that wields a charm like a blade, where each successful strike will provide you with a charge. When fully charged, The Empress: Charm card will be bestowed upon you, adding an edge of seduction and control to your tactical arsenal. You’ll acquire the Empress card after finishing Lindsay’s side story.

[h2]The Sun[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/c4cf37cda8a65772b24a7496ca1af82f34653c73.gif[/img]
And finally, introducing The Sun, a formidable Witch card that has one of the highest Penta summoning costs in the game. However, its unique prowess lies in a dynamic deployment cost, reducing each time with an ally’s sacrifice or strategic withdrawal. But wait - its brilliance doesn't end there! Upon its defeat or withdrawal from the battlefield, it triggers a radiant blast in the surrounding areas, leaving devastation in its wake! The Sun will be available for purchase from Mephista’s card shop after reaching a certain point in the story.

We hope that this Witch card tour has provided you with a glimpse of the distinct power that each card possesses! With over 20 unique Witch cards for you to collect and countless ways to build your very own deck, each battle invites you to an intricate dance of strategy and decision-making. Will you employ The Sun's explosive tendencies, or will you use The Empress' charm to sway the tide of battles?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983970/Affogato/

If you haven't already, be sure to follow our Steam and Twitter pages for upcoming updates. We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to you for being part of our journey, and here's to collecting all the Witch cards, and endless captivating moments in Affogato!

notes.title: New Update + Exclusive Discount!
notes.content:
Greetings, Magic Apprentices!

As Tokyo Game Show 2023 comes to a close, we would like to extend a heartfelt thank you to each one of you for embarking on this incredible adventure with us - the memories are nothing short of magical. Let’s dive back into those moments and revisit the event through a series of snapshots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/9a5afdc94db538abb48c5064734081d79bea683d.gif[/img]
[h2]Exclusive 15% Discount![/h2]

If Affogato has caught your interest, we’ve got something exciting to share! F[b]rom September 24 - October 8, Affogato will be 15% off.[/b] Plus, for those who revel in captivating game scores and unforgettable melodies, you can secure both the game and the OST at a special bundle deal of just $20 USD!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983970/Affogato/

[h2]New Update: Patch 1.0.19[/h2]

Hold onto your wands because we’ve just rolled out a new update, fresh from the [i]opentest beta branch[/i]! The update includes new phone dialogues with some of our enchanting characters, a new difficulty option, a new level challenge mode, on top of more feature optimizations and bug fixes. 

You can find the full list of updates below:

[h3]Content Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Game difficulty adjustment: We’ve added in a new “Normal” difficulty which will ensure a more balanced gameplay. “Normal” difficulty has been renamed to “Hard” difficulty. ”Hard” difficulty has been renamed to “Hell” difficulty.
[*] Added a new mode for players who have completed the game to replay previous reverse tower defense levels.
[*] New phone dialogues have been added for Aoi, Ema, and Hina, further enriching their storylines.
[/list]
[h3]Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the Witch Card Shop introduction: Detailed explanations of the witch cards have been added.
[*] When interacting with possessed NPCs, players will now have the option to start the battle through a secondary confirmation button instead of jumping straight into battle.
[*] Optimized the name of some checkpoints in certain levels.
[*] Optimized how checkpoints record the position and order of the Witch Cards.
[*] Increased the probability of triggering the positive effects of the Wheel of Fate. After triggering a negative effect, the next one will be a positive effect.
[*] Optimized “The World" healing target to prioritize units with the lowest percentage of health - not the units with the lowest value of health.
[*] The "Work Till You Die" and "Desensitization Therapy" achievements have been removed.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a potential issue in the final boss stage on Easy difficulty that could prevent the stage completion.
[*] Fixed the issue where level 2-2 could not be cleared if the enemies in the level are silenced.
[*] Fixed the issue where tasks from the previous week did not disappear in the second week.
[*] Fixed the occasional disappearance of the map, backpack, and phone buttons.
[*] Fixed a glitch in the third segment of the police side plot where making the wrong coffee could freeze the game.
[*] Fixed the issue where the memory effects did not disappear after reading a memory.
[*] Fixed an issue where the selection state of the first character would change when pressing 'F' to add points.
[*] Fixed a bug where players will be able to switch to other cards during the Witch card upgrade tutorial.
[*] Fixed some errors in conversational text and mobile phone news text.
[/list]
We hope you’ll enjoy this latest update! Once again we would like to extend our thanks and appreciation for your unwavering support for Affogato. The feedback and suggestions we have received from the community has been pivotal in our continuous journey of refining the game. 

Lastly, if Affogato has left a lasting impression on you, we'd be honored if you took a moment to review our game on Steam. Spreading the word by sharing it on your socials or recommending it to a friend who might enjoy it would mean a lot to us.

notes.title: Introducing Wandering Sword - A New Game from Spiral Up!
notes.content:
Greetings, Magic Apprentices!

We hope you’ve been having a wonderful time in Affogato! While you are brewing a coffee or engaging in reverse tower defense battles, you may like to check out another game our publisher - Spiral Up Games - has just launched!

[h2]Wandering Sword - An Epic Martial Arts RPG That Brings You On An Odyssey Through Ancient China[/h2]

[previewyoutube=s_TmuTcfMnw;full]https://youtu.be/s_TmuTcfMnw?si=l40v0wy-OKt2uAjy[/previewyoutube]
[h3]About The Game[/h3]
Embark on an immersive RPG journey with Wandering Sword, where pixel art meets the profound charm of ancient Chinese martial traditions. Journey through over 75 splendid locations capturing the essence of China's age-old allure, from bustling towns to captivating mountains and breathtaking landscapes. Build bonds with martial art enthusiasts, recruit them to join your adventure, and hone a vast array of combat techniques and weaponry. Accept your destiny and ascend to become the fabled Wuxia master that martial arts legends will speak of!

[i]Wandering Sword is an excellent debut game and has all the hallmarks of a classic RPG. Do not overlook this superb indie gem![/i]
9/10 - [b]RPG Fan[/b]

[i]Wandering Sword is a phenomenal 2.5D game that provides tons of unique mechanics to its gameplay.
[/i]9/10 - [b]KeenGamer[/b]

[h3]Innovative Dual-Combat Mechanics[/h3]
Remember how Affogato's innovative 'reverse tower defense' battles demanded strategic planning and quick-thinking, requiring you to meticulously plan moves while adapting swiftly to ever-changing scenarios? Wandering Sword evokes that same dynamism, offering players with a choice to select between turn-based or real time combat. Whether you're a fan of traditional RPGs or someone who loves lightning-paced action, it’s got you covered!

[h3]Building Bonds with Fellow Martial Artists[/h3]
In Affogato, you connect deeply with your café's customers, diving into their minds and stories. Similarly, Wandering Sword beckons players to form intricate relationships with lifelike NPCs. Recruit up to 14 exceptional martial artists, each boasting their own unique skills. As you explore the vibrant world of ancient China, forge deep bonds with them, craft strategic alliances and perhaps even romances in a world brimming with martial arts mystique.

[h3]Mastering Diverse Weapons & Techniques[/h3]
Just as you explore and amass a collection of over 20 unique Witch Cards in Affogato, each with distinct abilities shaping your battle strategies, Wandering Sword presents an equally intricate world. Uncover a vast array of martial arts techniques and weapon styles, each offering nuanced strategies and paths to mastery, each refining your path in this grand tale of martial prowess.

[h3]Embark on Thrilling Side Adventures[/h3]
Much like the bustling streets of Arorua brimming with quests, Wandering Sword offers a similar allure! As you navigate its expansive world, you'll stumble upon exhilarating side missions, from daring rescues to face-offs with rogue bandits. Each side quest not only adds depth to the main storyline, letting you delve deeper into the diverse corners of this Wuxia world.

Thank you for allowing us to share a glimpse of Wandering Sword! If you're keen on diving into a grand journey across Ancient China, aiding those in need, and honing a myriad of martial arts skills and weaponry, Wandering Sword is offering a 12% launch discount until 22 September. Don’t miss out on this opportunity!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1876890/Wandering_Sword/

Don't forget to continue brewing magical memories in Affogato, and stay tuned for more thrilling updates. Your support means everything, and we can't wait for you to embark on even more enchanting journeys!

notes.title: Public Test Branch Updates!
notes.content:
Hello, Magic Apprentices! 🌟

We hope you have been having fun in Affogato! Are you ready for a magical whirlwind of updates? Based on the feedback and suggestions we've received from all of you, we’re happy to share that we have new content coupled with some feature optimizations and bug fixes!

Our cauldron of updates introduces new phone dialogues for our beloved characters, fresh difficulty options, and a level challenge mode awaiting you after you complete it game, and you can experience it all in the [i]opentest[/i] beta branch now!

You can find out more about how to access the [i]opentest[/i] beta branch here 👇
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1983970/announcements/detail/3657539010854136316
After further review and testing, we will then roll out these new updates for everyone to enjoy!
Below are the feature optimizations and bug fixes completed in the [i]opentest[/i] beta branch:

[h2]Feature Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Game difficulty adjustment: We’ve added in a new “Normal” difficulty which will ensure a smoother gaming experience. “Normal” difficulty has been renamed to “Hard” difficulty. ”Hard” difficulty has been renamed to “Hell” difficulty, 
[*] Added a new mode for players who have completed the game to replay previous reverse tower defense levels.
[*] New phone dialogues have been added for Aoi, Ema, and Hina, further enriching their storylines.
[*] Improved the Witch Card Shop introduction: Detailed explanations of the witch cards have been added.
[*] When interacting with street demons, players will now have the option to fight the demon through a secondary confirmation button instead of jumping straight into battle.
[*] Optimized the visual effect when the Witch Card's hand cooldown is complete.
[*] Optimized the name of some checkpoints in levels to allow the player to easily understand which checkpoint they require.
[*] Optimized the position and order of the player’s Witch Card team at checkpoints.
[*] Increased the probability of triggering the positive effects of the Wheel of Fate. After triggering a negative effect, the next one will definitely be a positive effect.
[*] Remove the "Work Till You Die" and "Desensitization Therapy" achievements.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a potential issue in the final boss stage on easy difficulty that could prevent a player’s completion.
[*] Fixed a glitch in the third segment of the police side plot where making the wrong coffee could freeze the game.
[*] Fixed some errors in conversational text and mobile phone news text.
[*] Fixed the issue where tasks from the previous round did not disappear in the second round.
[*] Fixed the occasional disappearance of the map, backpack, and phone buttons.
[*] Fixed the issue where the memory effects did not disappear after reading a memory.
[*] Fixed an issue where the selection state of the first character would change when pressing 'F' to add points.
[*] Players will not be able to switch to other cards during the Witch card upgrade tutorial, the only option is to upgrade the Strength card.
[/list]
We hope you’ll enjoy this latest update! Our team will continue to work on improving and optimizing Affogato, and should you encounter any issues or have any suggestions, do share them with us on Discord or Steam! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983970/Affogato/

Once again, we would like to extend our gratitude for your continued support of Affogato, we are thrilled to have you as part of this bewitching adventure!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.17 Is Here!
notes.content:
Hello Magic Apprentices! 🌟

We trust you've been weaving spells and strategizing battles with gusto in Affogato! Few days ago, we opened up a public beta test branch, for you to experience the updates we've added. With your feedback and suggestions, we're excited to share that we are rolling out 1.0.17 version for everyone to enjoy!

[h2]New Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Opening the cafe during the day will add one random stat to Affogato.
[*] Changed the number of auto-save slots to 2.
[*] Older auto-saves will be overwritten automatically by newer ones.
[*] Added the option to purchase Witch cards in the preparation phase before a battle.
[*] Added a new option to reset all card levels and refund all Soul Shards in the upgrade interface.
[*] Optimized the BGM volume during voiceover scenes.
[*] Monsters killed on the beach stage now have markers displayed both above and below the water.
[*] Fixed an issue where Witch cards could interact with the floor when returning the card to your hand
[*] Enhanced the sound effect of Sera’s demon when she appears in Chapter 4. 
[*] Enhanced the sound effects for cards when it is on cooldown.
[*] Reduced the coffee-making seasoning requirement to trigger hidden dialogues with customers.
[*] You can now swipe on the game's mobile pages using a game controller.
[*] Added detailed descriptions of Witch Cards in the Witch Card shop.
[*] Added a battle cancellation option after interacting with a passerby.[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the oxygen bar displayed incorrectly after accessing a memory.
[*] Fixed an issue where some memory effects wouldn't disappear after accessing a memory.
[*] Resolved a problem where Affogato became unresponsive after sitting on Keke’s chair.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player’s team would unexpectedly change directions after interacting with a memory or without any input
[*] Fixed the issue where the volume of CGs was unable to be controlled
[*] Fixed a glitch where the player could access past dialogues from unintended interfaces
[*] Fixed an issue where the CG animation did not play after defeating the Chapter 1 boss.
[*] Fixed a problem where the achievement “Work till you die” was not granted when summoning the Hermit 3 times
[*] Fixed a bug where Affogato was positioned wrongly after spending time in a shop.
[*] Fixed a bug where incorrect text appeared when adding water to the coffee machine.
[*] Resolved the issue of mismatched text during Natalie’s side story second segment.
[*] Fixed the issue where items in the store would sometimes show the description of the last purchased item.
[*] Fixed the issue of the lingering Demon effect after defeating a demonic NPC.
[/list]
With the updates and refinements in Patch 1.0.17, we hope to bring a touch more magic to every moment you spend in Affogato. However - we would always welcome any feedback and suggestions, Simply let us know through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1983970/discussions/]Steam Community discussions[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1983970/Affogato/

Once again, we would like to extend our gratitude for your continued support of Affogato, we are thrilled to have you as part of this bewitching adventure!

notes.title: Latest Bug Fixes & New Public Test Branch!
notes.content:
Hello Magic Apprentices! 🌟

We hope you have been enjoying the magical adventure and exciting reverse tower defense battles in Affogato so far! Today, we’ll be talking about some of the bug fixes that we have been working on, as well as introducing a new Affogato [i]opentest[/i] beta branch on Steam!

[h2]Affogato [i]opentest[/i] Beta Branch[/h2]

In this new beta branch, we've rolled out new experimental updates to the game based on your feedback. We encourage you to check them out, experience the improvements, and let us know what you think - your inputs will go a long way in helping us refine the enchanting world of Affogato! 

Here are the steps to access the [i]opentest[/i] beta branch:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/a1a53ce1a126756153d0586ea60c63688ed90826.png[/img]
In your Steam library, right click on Affogato, then click on the "Properties" button on the pop up menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/25e5e0eeca9756fc95e75afcca51597c234557d6.png[/img]
In the Properties window, select "Betas" and under the “Beta Participation” dropdown menu, select “opentest” to opt in, and you are good to go!

Affogato should shortly update itself after, and the game should display as “Affogato [opentest]” in your Steam Library. That’s how you know that you have successfully opted in! If you’d like to swap back to the original game, simply go through the same steps as above and select “None”. 

[h2]Opentest branch precautions:[/h2]

The default branch and the opentest branch shares the same save path and we make our best to make sure the opentest branch save can be reused in the default branch. Just in case anything wrong happens, we still suggest you backup your savedata before switching to the opentest branch. The save path is: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Befun\Affogato\

Opentest branch won't update frequently, and we will eventually push the latest and the most stable version to the main game after a thorough quality assurance check. So in most cases, we still suggest you to stay in the default branch unless you do meet with certain issues or you are interested in the latest changes and want to conduct some experiments. If you want to switch from the opentest branch to the main branch, simply refer back to the method on how you opted in to the opentest branch.

Here’s a rundown of the experimental updates we’ve added:
[list]
[*] Opening the cafe during the day will add one random stat to Affogato.
[*] Changed the number of auto-save slots to 2.
[*] Older auto-saves will be overwritten automatically by newer ones.
[*] Added the option to purchase Witch cards in the preparation phase before a battle.
[*] Added a new option to reset all card levels and refund all Soul Shards in the upgrade interface.
[*] Optimized the BGM volume during voiceover scenes.
[*] Monsters killed on the beach stage now have markers displayed both above and below the water.
[*] Fixed an issue where Witch cards could interact with the floor when returning the card to your hand
[*] Enhanced the sound effect of Sera’s demon when she appears in Chapter 4. 
[*] Enhanced the sound effects for cards when it is on cooldown.
[*] Reduced the coffee-making seasoning requirement to trigger hidden dialogues with customers.
[*] You can now swipe on the game's mobile pages using a game controller.
[*] Added detailed descriptions of Witch Cards in the Witch Card shop.
[*] Added a battle cancellation option after interacting with a passerby.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

Now let’s talk about bugs! We've identified an issue where using certain Witch cards might cause your team to get stuck in battles. If you do encounter this, simply return the card to your hand, or reload one of your previous saves to continue the battle. We are working on fixing this in subsequent updates and would like to apologize for any inconvenience caused!

In addition, here are some other bug fixes that we are working on:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the oxygen bar displayed incorrectly after accessing a memory.
[*] Fixed an issue where some memory effects wouldn't disappear after accessing a memory.
[*] Resolved a problem where Affogato became unresponsive after sitting on Keke’s chair.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player’s team would unexpectedly change directions after interacting with a memory or without any input
[*] Fixed the issue where the volume of CGs was unable to be controlled
[*] Fixed a glitch where the player could access past dialogues from unintended interfaces
[*] Fixed an issue where the CG animation did not play after defeating the Chapter 1 boss.
[*] Fixed a problem where the achievement “Work till you die” was not granted when summoning the Hermit 3 times
[*] Fixed a bug where Affogato was positioned wrongly after spending time in a shop.
[*] Fixed a bug where incorrect text appeared when adding water to the coffee machine.
[*] Resolved the issue of mismatched text during Natalie’s side story second segment.
[*] Fixed the issue where items in the store would sometimes show the description of the last purchased item.
[*] Fixed the issue of the lingering Demon effect after defeating a demonic NPC.
[/list]
If you encounter any other bugs or have more feedback and suggestions for us, click on the "Feedback" button in the game’s title screen to fill out the survey, or let us know through the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1983970/discussions/]Steam Community discussions[/url]!

notes.content:
Hey Magic Apprentices!

We hope you are enjoying your magical journey in Affogato thus far! We’re here with our first update preview and some important news that we think you should know, especially during your coffee-making escapades and battle planning in the enchanting world of Arorua. So let's dive right in! 

[h2]Coffee-Making Tutorial Interaction Bug[/h2]
First of, we've received some reports that some players have encountered an issue with coffee machine being non-interactive, causing you not to move forward with the game. Our sincerest apologies for any brewing troubles this may have caused! After looking at it deeper, we found out that this issue arise mainly for those who had a chance to play the demo before. Specifically, certain old save file data might have affected the triggering of the coffee-making interaction in the game.

If you do encounter this issue, here's the fix! Simply start a new game, and everything should work like a charm in the new save file. 🌟 Make sure not to use your old save files! 

Rest assure that we will be fixing this bug in subsequent version updates, where we will disable the older demo version saves altogether to prevent this and other potential bugs from occurring!

[h2]Ongoing Fixes and Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] To make your coffee crafting more intuitive, we've removed the use of “water” during the coffee flavoring stage.
[*] We are optimizing specific challenges in Chapter 2 that might affect your Steam achievement rewards.[/list]
Stay tuned for more details on other updates and optimizations that we’ll be brewing up for you in future announcements! We're committed to continually polishing the game for the best possible player experience, and your feedback is our magical guidebook. If you face any issues, please do let us know on Discord or Steam. notes.title: Affogato - Development Progress & Update #2!
notes.content:
Hello Magic Apprentices!

We hope you're all doing well. We're excited to bring you another edition of our Development Progress & Update series. In this post, we will be discussing updates on a new narrative story arc, voice acting integrations, and our ongoing efforts to optimize game difficulty for Affogato.

[h2]Crafting Our New Story Arc[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/dde3ceafdd896db578a0bf8b188ad74ecfa3db82.jpg[/img]
We've been working hard recently on one of the plot points for the game. A new character has popped into the world of Affogato's cafe - a spirited indie game developer working on a game where the key theme is 'delivering goods'. This charming new addition is our playful homage to a famous game developer and his much-loved debut work which is based on the same theme. 

In the process of crafting this character and her narrative arc, we've taken the liberty of weaving in snippets of our own experiences. As indie game developers, we face a plethora of challenges and victories, from the euphoria of solving a complex programming issue to the strain of long debugging sessions. Through this character, we've tried to encapsulate some of these ups and downs, infusing a piece of our journey into the heart of Affogato.

We're excited to see how this character will resonate with you, as her story reflects not just the journey of a fictional game developer, but our own personal and collective experiences as well. We wanted to do more than just share a character; we wanted to share a slice of our life, our passion, and our perseverance in the field of game development.

[h2]Integration of Voice Acting[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/7df5c0990945133a0cd41ba93ca41f899ec77949.png[/img]
Next, we are now in the process of integrating voice acting in three languages: English, Chinese, and Japanese. We are diligently finalizing the script, paying special attention to the subtleties of each language to ensure cultural accuracy and relatability. We are excited for the VO to breathe life into Affogato's characters, unfolding their unique stories and personal journeys. We also hope for the effort to deepen the emotional connection between you and the vibrant characters that inhabit the world of Affogato.

[h2]Game Difficulty Balancing[/h2]

Next, we've also received feedback that some battles could be quite challenging, and we're working to strike a balance, ensuring the game is exciting without being overly difficult In Affogato. For example, we have incorporated a variety of witch cards that you will discover as you progress in the game. You would be able to upgrade them and create different lineup combinations, making battles more manageable and enjoyable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/71d499a4e5184c17af3965060edbe7c166c0ba99.gif[/img]
[i]The Hermit grants 1 Penta each time it's charged up![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/75e84220d8f61b764c73a4c0a1d5888ad76b926a.gif[/img]
[i]The World heals the ally with lowest HP once it's charged up![/i]

That concludes this edition of our development progress update for Affogato! We hope you enjoyed learning about our latest improvements and we are looking forward to bringing you more updates soon. Your input and suggestions are invaluable in helping us craft the best possible experience for you. Be sure to stay tuned for future updates, and we're excited for you to join us on this enchanting journey!

notes.title: Affogato - Introducing Sera, the Legendary Witch!
notes.content:
Hey Magic Apprentices!

Today, we're thrilled to introduce you to one of Affogato's most enigmatic characters, Sera, the mysterious witch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/01f6f61ad02f1d95ff8b207b6fcb1e10b1355591.gif[/img]

In the captivating lore of Arorua City, Sera is revered as a legendary witch who assumed control of the city three years ago. When you first meet her in the game, she appears as a youthful teenage witch with striking white hair and a mysterious aura that sets her apart from the rest. Yet, her confident demeanor and composure reveal a depth of experience and wisdom that far surpasses her seemingly young age.

Sera shares a fascinating past connection with Affogato, and as you progress through the game, their intriguing bond gradually comes to light, keeping you engrossed and eager to discover more about their intertwined story.

[h2]Hobbies, Interests and Abilities[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/8a632ef76cc6ea72026b8f07644a4d491c728cd6.jpg[/img]
Sera's interests are diverse, spanning from magical research and playing chess to indulging in cosplay. Recently, she has adopted the persona of a high school girl, taking on the role of student council president, which leaves one wondering about her motives behind this. These various aspects of Sera's character enrich her mysterious nature, adding layers of depth and complexity.

In addition, Sera's expertise in witchcraft is well renowned in Arorua City. Her mastery over various forms of magic is both awe-inspiring and formidable, and her profound understanding of magical theory and application allows her to conjure powerful spells and enchantments, further enhancing her status as a legendary witch.

We hope you enjoyed this brief introduction to Sera's backstory! As we continue to develop Affogato, we'd like to express our gratitude for your support. Your valuable feedback over the past months has strengthened our motivation to keep improving Affogato!

We can't wait to share more about the game in the coming months, so stay tuned for more updates, add Affogato to your wishlist and prepare to set off on a mesmerizing adventure in an enchanting magical world!

notes.title: Affogato - Development Progress and Updates!
notes.content:
Hey Magic Apprentices!

When we released the Affogato demo during Steam Next Fest in February 2023, we received loads of amazing feedback and suggestions, and we can't thank you enough for your patience in playing our game. We appreciate the diversity of your questions and have been more than happy to address as many as possible. Some suggestions were challenging, but they were also very interesting and valuable for our development process! 

As such, we are excited to present an update on Affogato's development, and share the improvements we've made so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/ab071ea8f8acb53085540862cc80dc2b9afdb5a4.png[/img]

[h2]Side Quests for Natalie & Lindsay[/h2]
Do you remember Natalie and Lindsay from our demo? Natalie is a senior journalist running the "Goddess Chronicles" in Arorua City, and Lindsay is a college student with social anxiety, looking for a part-time job to help her develop her social skills. Currently, the development of Natalie and Lindsay's side quests has been completed, and we believe the events surrounding them will bring surprises to you! We are still in the midst of developing other characters' side quests which including some male characters that we will be introducing soon!

In Affogato, each character you encounter holds a significant importance in the game, and it's up to you to determine how to develop relationships with them. Every choice you make can shape your adventure, leading to a variety of potential outcomes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/df5d441bbe26293e127beaf4ef8b155ee1e8edb3.png[/img]

[h2]Battle Difficulty Adjustments[/h2]
In response to players' feedback on the battle difficult level, we initially introduced various difficulty options to cater to different preferences, however we noticed that some of you still find certain challenges demanding. As such, we have made some adjustments to the battle mechanics, and our quality control team is currently testing these changes. We have also enhanced the special effects and art for the third and fourth chapter battle levels, making them more visually rich and stimulating.

[h2]Witchery Café Is Getting An Upgrade![/h2]
Speaking of special effects and art, as we strive to enhance the visual experience in our game, we're excited to announce that we're currently working on the renovation of Witchery Café! To give you a sneak peek into the process, we're sharing two design drafts with you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/32c029740a9f86a1927ce251c92acb0e3cd658e7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/2abaecfc4cc6e492159192cd7fee2926b55724b1.png[/img]
[i]Which do you prefer - 1 or 2?[/i]

We would love to hear your thoughts on which style you prefer! Feel free to share your opinions in the comments section below. And as an added bonus, we've hidden some easter eggs within the images for you to discover! Can you find them all?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/d788e95a7a3277e255e1be9276bc1d2dd0736a56.png[/img]

[h2]Voice Acting Updates and Character Improvements[/h2]
We've had numerous fans of Japanese RPGs that share some suggestions about voice acting, and we're thrilled to share some exciting updates on this front! Majority of voice acting work has been wrapped up, and we're now focusing on fine-tuning the configurations and making final adjustments. In addition to voice acting, we have also adjusted some character illustrations and dialogue expressions to better showcase their personalities and enhance immersion. Upon the game's release, we're excited for you to explore a colorful and dynamic Arorua City. Remember to put on your headphones for the best experience when playing!

Lastly, we'd like to express our gratitude for your support as Affogato marks the exciting debut for Befun Studio. Our dedicated team is always eager to learn, grow, and overcome challenges, and your invaluable insights have not only helped us validate ideas but also strengthened our motivation to continue improving Affogato!

We hope you're as excited about Affogato as we are, and we can't wait to share more about the game in the coming months. Stay tuned for more updates, add Affogato to your wishlist and prepare to set off on a mesmerizing adventure in an enchanting magical world!

notes.title: Affogato - Steam Next Fest Trailer + New Demo Launch!
notes.content:
Hey Magic Apprentices!

It's been almost half a year since the last Affogato demo was made public, and we're excited to announce that our [b]new demo for Affogato is now live for a limited time only[/b], and we welcome you to try it!

We would also like to take this opportunity to share with you the Affogato Steam Next Fest Trailer!

[previewyoutube=e8doDChbKZ8;full][/previewyoutube]
Our new demo offers about two hours worth of playtime and you will play the role of Affogato, who together with the demon Mephista, restarts a café business in the city of Arorua. You will become a barista and brew coffee for your customers while using your mystical abilities to enter their minds and help them defeat their inner demons through reverse tower defense battle levels. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/2ac2a0bf2d10da7c53c37104059e77e7e21c3d32.gif[/img]

The city of Arorua never sees daylight, but you will still need to plan your daily schedule and organize your time wisely. In each day's cycle, you decide if it is better to do more business to improve your income, visit the bookstore and beauty salon in the city to improve your attributes, or forge closer relationships with your customers and solve their problems. It's all up to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/be6be63e4e736bf902025479f5cf8f68b559ac48.png[/img]

These are what have been improved and added in comparison to the previous demo - 
[list]
[*] Added Steam Festival Demo Reward: Café Limited Edition Skin American Vintage - Red
[*] Added two days of main storyline
[*] Added part of Natalie and Lindsay's side story
[*] Added difficulty selection function, currently there are three difficulties
[*] Added a map system where you can switch scenes through the map
[*] Added cell phone system, including mobile news, chat and BGM switching functions
[*] Added new battle levels and optimized the battle experience
[*] Optimized the collision detection of the scene, adjusted the lens, color tone, size and other content
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686068/b7a5e1b2725ef774efbb9d2fc151934813125ac1.jpg[/img]

Some additional notes.
[list]
[*] Players who play the Steam Next Fest Demo will get a [b]Limited Edition Café Skin in the official version of Affogato[/b] (Please note: You don't need to complete the demo to get the skin. The skin will be unlocked in the official version of the game.)
[*] Please do not delete the trial version of the archive record, and ensure that steam's cloud archive function has been turned on.
[*] If the loading screen takes too long, please wait for a while.
[*] Please restart the game manually when you switch to another language.
[*] If you encounter bugs or can't start the game and other problems, please join our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/wEBNr3v2yj]https://discord.gg/wEBNr3v2yj[/url] to inform us about the problem and submit your archive file and computer configuration details to the administrator. Thank you for your support and help!
[/list]
If you enjoyed Affogato, do wishlist the game and share it with your friends who may like it. Your support means the world to us!

Added a map system where you can switch scenes through the map
Added cell phone system, including mobile news, chat and BGM switching functions
Added new battle levels and optimized the battle experience

tags.bug: If you encounter bugs or can't start the game and other problems, please join our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/wEBNr3v2yj]https://discord.gg/wEBNr3v2yj[/url] to inform us about the problem and submit your archive file and computer configuration details to the administrator. Thank you for your support and help!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Thank you very much for your support! We are receiving all the messages and bug reports from you. Please check the first patch notes below.

[list]
[*] Fix the problem of residual black shadow when Serra's illustration fades out
[*] Fix the problem that the boss battle may get stuck
[*] Fix the problem that the music may disappear at the beginning of the game
[*] Make the animation transition of Affogato smoother
[*] Fix the problem that the battle scene will suddenly become brighter
[*] Optimize some in-game text content
[*]Fix the problem of BUFF effects not disappearing
[*]Fix the problem of URL abnormality by clicking in start menu
[/list]

Thanks again for playing our demo! If you have any question or bug report, please join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/j3VEZZxa]https://discord.gg/j3VEZZxa[/url]
We would like to here your opinion about the demo. Please check the questionnaire: [url=https://forms.gle/4t7H7g278maeX6129]https://forms.gle/4t7H7g278maeX6129[/url]
